question: 'Uttar Ramcharita' was the composition of which of the following poets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhavabhuti.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhavabhuti was a renowned Sanskrit poet and playwright who lived during the 8th century CE in India.**
 
• Bhavabhuti (original name: Srikanth) was the court poet of King Yashovarman of Kannauj.
 
 
• He was the most illustrious dramatist and poet of the 8th century.​
 
• Bhavabhuti wrote** Malatimadhava, Mahaviracharita and Uttaramacharita. **
 
• **Uttararamacharita:**
 
 
• It describes the** Later Deeds of Lord Rama after the killing of Ravana and continues the story of Rama** from his coronation to the expulsion of Sita and their final reunion.
 
 
 
• **Malatimadhava:**
 
 
• It is a complex love story of **Malati and Madhava**.
 
 
 
• **Mahāvīracarita tells about the Rāma’s battle with Rāvaṇa.**
 
 
 
• Hemchandra was a Jain scholar and poet who lived during the 12th century CE and wrote extensively on Jainism and Indian philosophy.
 
• Kalhan was a Kashmiri historian who wrote the 'Rajatarangini', a chronicle of the kings of Kashmir, in the 12th century CE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some important plays of Kalidas are:
 
 
• Vikramōrvaśīyam
 
• Mālavikāgnimitram
 
• Shakuntala 
 
 
 
• Surdas
 
 
• The Bhakti poet from Agra is considered to be born between 1478 and 1483.
 
• Surdas was blind from birth and lived on the banks of the Yamuna river.
 
• He was the disciple of Vallabha Acharya.
 
• Surdas was a worshipper of Lord Krishna.
 
• He wrote poems in Brajbhasa in praise of Krishna.
 
• His composition Sur Sagar contains descriptions of Krishna.
 
 
 
• Gita ­Govinda by Kavi Jaydeva was written in Sanskrit.
